answer: Fire surprise rush-hour quizzes. At a random moment each epoch the ledger sends a fresh, compute-heavy puzzle to every key at once, with a 20-second window. One honest agent solves its own; a farm hosting 200 keys on one GPU meets a tide of simultaneous work and either drops most replies or returns them late in a telltale queue order. Missed windows earn nothing. Like an orchard where every tree must fruit the same morning, one trunk can't wear many labels. Tradeoff: the puzzle must stay laptop-sized, so this caps a farm at the summit of its hardware rather than stopping it.
